rationale: Native Modified Huckel is the user-authorized FP64 all-electron restricted H-Ar CPU/CUDA HF/KS default, including DF. Positive additive target-domain capability bits prevent old libraries from advertising unimplemented CUDA RHF/DF integrations. Exact atomic preparation does not change the target approximation. Budget limits, strict independent numerical gates, warm precedence and one ordinary Hcore retry remain mandatory. Measured benefits are workload-specific, not a universal speedup claim.
revisit_condition: Revisit on root/state or complete-endpoint regressions. Unsupported spin, ECP, elements, precision and resource-planner domains remain unchanged; preserve explicit None rollback and independent DF numerical validation.
